defects_found.location: main.tex Related work, 'We are the first to show that language models accept individual incorrect options when each is verified alone as true or false'
defects_found.description: Unsupported and self-contradicting novelty claim. The same paragraph attributes this finding to Wang et al. (COLING 2025), so it cannot be a first for this paper.

defects_found.location: main.tex Related work, description of wang2025llms (verification relates to choice; models still choose when correct option replaced and NONE offered)
defects_found.description: The citation record shows the paper was reached only through search snippets with the pages blocked, and its summary supports only 'least incorrect option'. The detailed content attributed to it is not verified by the evidence.
The C3 runs, which supply the main results, used CLI 2.1.318. 2.1.317 applies only to S1 and C2. The paper reports one version for all calls on 3-4 Nov.
defects_found.evidence: exps/c3/PREREGISTRATION.md line 9; results/claims.json cli_version sourced from loop/STEER.md

defects_found.location: main.tex Sec 3.5: 'thirteen competitions, including six monthly arXiv-derived sets from December 2025 to May 2026'
defects_found.description: The pre-registered bank lists seven arXiv-derived sets (1225, 0126, 0226, 0326, 0426, 0526 and 0626) plus apex-shortlist and five contests. The description miscounts the composition and omits the June 2026 set, and the family split depends on this classification.

defects_found.location: main.tex H3 paragraph and abstract: 'verifying with sonnet did not reduce the selection effect'
defects_found.description: Only the haiku-pick result is reported (d=+0.02, inconclusive). The sonnet-pick H3 contrast is omitted. It is d=+0.04 with one-sided p=0.049, which is at the margin and uncorrected. Also, 'removed none of the inflation' rests on a non-significant test, not on evidence of absence.

defects_found.location: main.tex abstract: primary test 'inconclusive because unsolved problems came almost entirely from one source'
defects_found.description: Mostly consistent with artifacts (6 of 87 contest problems unsolved). However, the headline 'Holm-confirmed' effects (H1u, H2u) are within-stratum tests that do not isolate competence from source. The abstract's framing and the title ('Beyond Its Competence ...') overstate what the failed primary test establishes.

The key and citation text say 2025 and the title is 'Towards an AI co-scientist', but the entry lists title 'Accelerating scientific discovery with Co-Scientist' and year 2026. Version and venue are mixed, so the entry is inconsistent with the cited arXiv version that the URL points to.
